title: processkit shared-server health response
description: Body of the unauthenticated health endpoint GET /healthz (access-control@v1 PK-ACC-033, PK-ACC-052). The state values and the checks behind them are owned by mcp-context-serving@v1 (PK-MCP-046, PK-MCP-047). The body has no other member, so it reveals no item names, counts, or rules.
